schema:
CREATE TABLE table_announcements (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	hash TEXT, 
	text TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE table_languages_profiles (
	"profileId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cutoff INTEGER, 
	"originalFormat" INTEGER, 
	items TEXT NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	"mustContain" TEXT, 
	"mustNotContain" TEXT, 
	tag TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("profileId")
)

CREATE TABLE table_settings_languages (
	code3 TEXT NOT NULL, 
	code2 TEXT, 
	code3b TEXT, 
	enabled INTEGER, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code3)
)

CREATE TABLE alembic_version (
	version_num VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT alembic_version_pkc PRIMARY KEY (version_num)
)

CREATE TABLE "system" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	configured TEXT, 
	updated TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "table_settings_notifier" (
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	enabled INTEGER, 
	url TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (name)
)

CREATE TABLE "table_shows" (
	"tvdbId" INTEGER, 
	"alternativeTitles" TEXT, 
	audio_language TEXT, 
	created_at_timestamp DATETIME, 
	ended TEXT, 
	fanart TEXT, 
	"imdbId" TEXT, 
	"lastAired" TEXT, 
	monitored TEXT, 
	overview TEXT, 
	path TEXT NOT NULL, 
	poster TEXT, 
	"profileId" INTEGER, 
	"seriesType" TEXT, 
	"sonarrSeriesId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"sortTitle" TEXT, 
	tags TEXT, 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at_timestamp DATETIME, 
	year TEXT, "originalLanguage" TEXT, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_table_shows PRIMARY KEY ("sonarrSeriesId"), 
	CONSTRAINT "fk_series_profileId_languages_profiles" FOREIGN KEY("profileId") REFERENCES table_languages_profiles ("profileId") ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT unique_table_shows_path UNIQUE (path), 
	FOREIGN KEY("profileId") REFERENCES table_languages_profiles ("profileId") ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	UNIQUE (path)
)

CREATE TABLE "table_episodes" (
	audio_codec TEXT, 
	audio_language TEXT, 
	created_at_timestamp DATETIME, 
	episode INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	episode_file_id INTEGER, 
	"failedAttempts" TEXT, 
	ffprobe_cache BLOB, 
	file_size BIGINT DEFAULT '0', 
	format TEXT, 
	missing_subtitles TEXT, 
	monitored TEXT, 
	path TEXT NOT NULL, 
	resolution TEXT, 
	"sceneName" TEXT, 
	season INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"sonarrEpisodeId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"sonarrSeriesId" INTEGER, 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at_timestamp DATETIME, 
	video_codec TEXT, "absoluteEpisode" INTEGER, "tvdbId" INTEGER, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_table_episodes PRIMARY KEY ("sonarrEpisodeId"), 
	CONSTRAINT "fk_sonarrSeriesId_episodes" FOREIGN KEY("sonarrSeriesId") REFERENCES table_shows ("sonarrSeriesId") ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY("sonarrSeriesId") REFERENCES table_shows ("sonarrSeriesId") ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "table_history" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	action INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	language TEXT, 
	provider TEXT, 
	score INTEGER, 
	"sonarrEpisodeId" INTEGER, 
	"sonarrSeriesId" INTEGER, 
	subs_id TEXT, 
	subtitles_path TEXT, 
	timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	video_path TEXT, 
	matched TEXT, 
	not_matched TEXT, 
	"upgradedFromId" INTEGER, score_out_of INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT "fk_sonarrEpisodeId_history" FOREIGN KEY("sonarrEpisodeId") REFERENCES table_episodes ("sonarrEpisodeId") ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT "fk_sonarrSeriesId_history" FOREIGN KEY("sonarrSeriesId") REFERENCES table_shows ("sonarrSeriesId") ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY("sonarrEpisodeId") REFERENCES table_episodes ("sonarrEpisodeId") ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY("sonarrSeriesId") REFERENCES table_shows ("sonarrSeriesId") ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY("upgradedFromId") REFERENCES table_history (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "table_blacklist" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	language TEXT, 
	provider TEXT, 
	sonarr_episode_id INTEGER, 
	sonarr_series_id INTEGER, 
	subs_id TEXT, 
	timestamp DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT "fk_sonarrEpisodeId_blacklist" FOREIGN KEY(sonarr_episode_id) REFERENCES table_episodes ("sonarrEpisodeId") ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT "fk_sonarrSeriesId_blacklist" FOREIGN KEY(sonarr_series_id) REFERENCES table_shows ("sonarrSeriesId") ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(sonarr_episode_id) REFERENCES table_episodes ("sonarrEpisodeId") ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(sonarr_series_id) REFERENCES table_shows ("sonarrSeriesId") ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "table_shows_rootfolder" (
	accessible INTEGER, 
	error TEXT, 
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	path TEXT, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_table_shows_rootfolder PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE "table_movies" (
	"alternativeTitles" TEXT, 
	audio_codec TEXT, 
	audio_language TEXT, 
	created_at_timestamp DATETIME, 
	"failedAttempts" TEXT, 
	fanart TEXT, 
	ffprobe_cache BLOB, 
	file_size BIGINT DEFAULT '0', 
	format TEXT, 
	"imdbId" TEXT, 
	missing_subtitles TEXT, 
	monitored TEXT, 
	movie_file_id INTEGER, 
	overview TEXT, 
	path TEXT NOT NULL, 
	poster TEXT, 
	"profileId" INTEGER, 
	"radarrId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	resolution TEXT, 
	"sceneName" TEXT, 
	"sortTitle" TEXT, 
	tags TEXT, 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	"tmdbId" TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at_timestamp DATETIME, 
	video_codec TEXT, 
	year TEXT, "originalLanguage" TEXT, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_table_movies PRIMARY KEY ("radarrId"), 
	CONSTRAINT "fk_movies_profileId_languages_profiles" FOREIGN KEY("profileId") REFERENCES table_languages_profiles ("profileId") ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT unique_table_movies_path UNIQUE (path), 
	CONSTRAINT "unique_table_movies_tmdbId" UNIQUE ("tmdbId"), 
	FOREIGN KEY("profileId") REFERENCES table_languages_profiles ("profileId") ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	UNIQUE (path), 
	UNIQUE ("tmdbId")
)

CREATE TABLE "table_history_movie" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	action INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	language TEXT, 
	provider TEXT, 
	"radarrId" INTEGER, 
	score INTEGER, 
	subs_id TEXT, 
	subtitles_path TEXT, 
	timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	video_path TEXT, 
	matched TEXT, 
	not_matched TEXT, 
	"upgradedFromId" INTEGER, score_out_of INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT "fk_radarrId_history_movie" FOREIGN KEY("radarrId") REFERENCES table_movies ("radarrId") ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY("upgradedFromId") REFERENCES table_history_movie (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY("radarrId") REFERENCES table_movies ("radarrId") ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "table_blacklist_movie" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	language TEXT, 
	provider TEXT, 
	radarr_id INTEGER, 
	subs_id TEXT, 
	timestamp DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT "fk_radarrId_blacklist_movie" FOREIGN KEY(radarr_id) REFERENCES table_movies ("radarrId") ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(radarr_id) REFERENCES table_movies ("radarrId") ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "table_movies_rootfolder" (
	accessible INTEGER, 
	error TEXT, 
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	path TEXT, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_table_movies_rootfolder PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE table_episodes_subtitles (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	language TEXT NOT NULL, 
	hi BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	forced BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	path TEXT, 
	size BIGINT, 
	embedded_track_id INTEGER, 
	"sonarrEpisodeId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	"sonarrSeriesId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uc_external_episodes_subtitles UNIQUE (path, "sonarrSeriesId", "sonarrEpisodeId", language, forced, hi), 
	CONSTRAINT uc_embedded_episodes_subtitles UNIQUE (embedded_track_id, "sonarrSeriesId", "sonarrEpisodeId", language, forced, hi), 
	FOREIGN KEY("sonarrEpisodeId") REFERENCES table_episodes ("sonarrEpisodeId") ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY("sonarrSeriesId") REFERENCES table_shows ("sonarrSeriesId") ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE table_movies_subtitles (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	language TEXT NOT NULL, 
	hi BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	forced BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	path TEXT, 
	size BIGINT, 
	embedded_track_id INTEGER, 
	"radarrId" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uc_external_movies_subtitles UNIQUE (path, "radarrId", language, forced, hi), 
	CONSTRAINT uc_embedded_movies_subtitles UNIQUE (embedded_track_id, "radarrId", language, forced, hi), 
	FOREIGN KEY("radarrId") REFERENCES table_movies ("radarrId") ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_episodes_season_episode ON table_episodes (season, episode)
CREATE INDEX ix_history_video_path_language ON table_history (video_path, language)
CREATE INDEX ix_history_action_timestamp ON table_history (action, timestamp)
CREATE INDEX ix_history_movie_video_path_language ON table_history_movie (video_path, language)
CREATE INDEX ix_history_movie_action_timestamp ON table_history_movie (action, timestamp)
CREATE INDEX ix_blacklist_provider_subs_id ON table_blacklist (provider, subs_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_blacklist_movie_provider_subs_id ON table_blacklist_movie (provider, subs_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_episodes_subtitles_composite ON table_episodes_subtitles ("sonarrEpisodeId", path, embedded_track_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_movies_subtitles_composite ON table_movies_subtitles ("radarrId", path, embedded_track_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_episodes_subtitles_language_hi_forced ON table_episodes_subtitles (language, hi, forced)
CREATE INDEX ix_episodes_subtitles_episode_path_track ON table_episodes_subtitles ("sonarrEpisodeId", path, embedded_track_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_movies_subtitles_language_hi_forced ON table_movies_subtitles (language, hi, forced)
CREATE INDEX ix_movies_subtitles_movie_path_track ON table_movies_subtitles ("radarrId", path, embedded_track_id)
